task.title: Viewing database logs
task.shortdesc: To view repository usage logs stored in the Red Hat Quay PostgreSQL database, you can query the logentry tables with the psql CLI tool.

ul.li: You have installed the psql CLI tool.

step.cmd: Enter the following command to log in to your Red Hat Quay PostgreSQL database:
Optional. Enter the following command to display the tables list of your PostgreSQL database:

info.codeblock: List of relations Schema | Name | Type | Owner --------+----------------------------+-------+---------- public | logentry | table | quayuser public | logentry2 | table | quayuser public | logentry3 | table | quayuser public | logentrykind | table | quayuser ...

step.cmd: Enter the following command to return a list of repository_ids that are required to return log information:

info.codeblock: quay=> SELECT id, name FROM repository;

step.cmd: Enter the following command to use the logentry3 relation to show log information about one of your repositories:

info.codeblock:
id | kind_id | account_id | performer_id | repository_id | datetime | ip | metadata_json
59 | 14 | 2 | 1 | 6 | 2024-05-13 15:51:01.897189 | 192.168.1.130 | {"repo": "api-repo", "namespace": "test-org"}
info.p: In this example, the following information is returned:

dlentry.dd: Specifies the unique identifier for the log entry.
Specifies the action that was performed. In this example, 14 maps to creating a repository (create_repo).
Specifies the account that performed the action.
Specifies the performer of the action.
Specifies the repository that the action was performed on. In this example, 6 correlates to the api-repo repository from the previous step.
Specifies the IP address where the action was performed.
Specifies metadata information, including the name of the repository and its namespace.
Specifies the time when the action was performed.
